definitions.explanation: An official form submitted to the local ward or city office when moving into a new municipality in Japan.

examples.japanese: {転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{早|はや}め→早め：11176_hayame⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{出|だ}そう→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Let's submit the moving-in notification early.

examples.japanese: {引|ひ}っ{越|こ}し⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧{14日|じゅうよっか}⟦{以内|いない}→以内：01317_inai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{出|だ}す→出す：01087_dasu⟧。
examples.english: Submit the moving-in notification within 14 days after moving.

examples.japanese: {転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{転出|てんしゅつ}→転出：25698_tenshutsu⟧⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{必要|ひつよう}→必要：00846_hitsuyou⟧です。
examples.english: A moving-out certificate is required for the moving-in notification.

notes:
{転入届|てんにゅうとどけ} must be submitted within 14 days of moving to a new municipality. You need to bring your ⟦{転出|てんしゅつ}→転出：25698_tenshutsu⟧⟦{証明書|しょうめいしょ}→証明書：09785_shoumeisho⟧ from your previous location.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{提出|ていしゅつ}する→提出する：19644_teishutsusuru⟧ (to submit a moving-in notification)
- {転入届|てんにゅうとどけ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{届出|とどけで}→届出：07555_todokede⟧ (filing a moving-in notification)
